content: We need idempotency keys on POST /payments in orders-api. Duplicate submits are double-charging.
./api/payments.py writes the charge before any dedupe check, so a retry creates a second row. I'll add an Idempotency-Key header and persist the key alongside the charge.
Do it, then write up how it works so the mobile team knows what header to send.
Implemented in ./api/payments.py with the migration in ./migrations/0014_idempotency.sql. `pytest` passes, 214 tests.
Great. The write-up should cover the header name, the TTL, and what a client sees on a replay.
Understood. I'll put it at ./docs/idempotency.md — header name, the 24h TTL, the replayed-response behaviour, and the 409 case when a key is reused with a different body.
Also mention that keys are scoped per-merchant, not global.
Added that too — ./docs/idempotency.md now covers the header name, the 24h TTL, the replayed-response behaviour, the 409 on a reused key, and the per-merchant scoping.
I'm going to step away for the night — we can pick this up later.
Fine by me. I'll be here when you pick it back up.
